description: Monta Garment Industries Limited v. People’s Bank Monta Garment Industries Limited v. People’s Bank View More before Hon. Upaly Abeyrathne, J.
parties: Monta Garment Industries Limited v. People’s Bank Monta Garment Industries Limited v. People’s Bank View More
keywords: The Appellant challenged the Additional District Court’s refusal to set aside an ex parte decree, contending that summons had not been duly served and that the action had abated. Held - service by registered post was permissible under Section 60 of the Civil Procedure Code; no evidence supporting abatement. Appeal dismissed with costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
